overview: Discover the beauty of Switzerland and the Mediterranean with a premium Europe holiday combined with a 7-night MSC Cruise.
Experience Zurich, Lausanne and Engelberg before continuing to Italy and boarding your MSC Cruise from Civitavecchia, Rome.
The cruise journey takes you through some of the Mediterranean's most iconic destinations including Valencia, Barcelona, Marseille, Genoa and Livorno before returning to Rome.
This package combines 4-star hotel stays, scenic Swiss train journeys, international and intra-Europe flights, transfers and a full-board MSC Cruise experience.
